legal.case_number.description: The case_number column represents the number of precedents cited in a legal case. Format: number. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.case_number.meaning: The case_number column represents the number of precedents cited in a legal case.

legal.evidence.description: The value 1 indicates that the evidence presented in the document is admissible. Format: string. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.evidence.meaning: The value 1 indicates that the evidence presented in the document is admissible.

legal.first_judge.description: The value represents whether a judge was assigned to the case, with 1 indicating that a judge was assigned. Format: 1 or 0. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.first_judge.meaning: The value represents whether a judge was assigned to the case, with 1 indicating that a judge was assigned.

legal.hearing_year.description: The year in which the legal hearing took place. Format: number
legal.hearing_year.meaning: The year in which the legal hearing took place.

legal.judgment_year.description: The year in which the judgment was made. Format: number
legal.judgment_year.meaning: The year in which the judgment was made.

legal.legal_basis_num.description: The number of statutory bases or references used in a legal case document. Format: number. If the document does not mention it: 0
legal.legal_basis_num.meaning: The number of statutory bases or references used in a legal case document.
